_meta.description: Manually curated official/documented reference figures — no live official API for heat-mortality data exists (see docs/architecture.md and docs/sources.md). Every entry here must trace exactly to docs/sources.md; never adjust or round a number to make a comparison look starker.

figures.context: Temperatures reached 50°C across Punjab (population ~120 million); fewer than 5% of all deaths in Pakistan are registered in any way.
figures.citation: Amnesty International, "Uncounted: Invisible deaths of older people and children during climate disasters in Pakistan," May 2025.

figures.context: Amnesty's investigation found over 95% of fatalities during that same crisis were catalogued under other diagnoses.
figures.citation: Amnesty International 2025 report, as reported by Inside Climate News, June 2025.

figures.context: Some tallies report 7,900+ admissions. Figures are themselves believed to understate the true toll.
figures.citation: 2024 Pakistan heat wave event reporting (AP/BBC-sourced aggregation).

figures.context: Across five named Lahore public hospitals (Services, General, Mayo, Jinnah, Sir Ganga Ram) — a real, sourced number, but a one-day snapshot that vanished from public view the next day.
